facts.label: Global space economy, calendar year 2024

sources.name: Space Foundation, The Space Report 2025 Q2 press release, July 22, 2025
GlobeNewswire wire copy of the same Space Foundation release (issuer: Space Foundation)

facts.notes: Stated as $613 billion, no decimal, for calendar 2024, with 7.8% year-over-year growth and the first year above $600B. Same release: commercial sector 78% of the total, government 22% ($132B, of which US $77B). Space Foundation is the originating party. facts.label: NASA Moon Base planned investment, Phases 1 and 2, 2026 through 2032

sources.name: NASA, Building the Moon Base presentation, Ignition event, March 24, 2026
Spaceflight Now, NASA outlines ambitious $20 billion plan for moon base, William Harwood, March 25, 2026
The Planetary Society, Ignition: A new series of NASA initiatives, March 24, 2026

facts.notes: The literal figure appears in no NASA written document found. It originates as Administrator Isaacman's spoken statement at the March 24, 2026 Ignition event: 'we will invest approximately $20 billion over the next seven years.' NASA's own deck states per-phase investment: Phase 1 (2026-2028) $10B, Phase 2 (2029-2032) $10B, Phase 3 (2033-2036) $10B+. Planned investment, not an appropriation; the FY2027 request has no $20B line item. Do not conflate with the $6B CLPS 2.0 cap or with roughly $30B three-phase framings.

derived.label: Global space spending per second, at 2024's rate
derived.notes: Rate visualization, not a measurement. 2024's annual estimate divided into 31,536,000 seconds (a 365-day year). The vintage is the choice: 2024 is the latest full year published.

derived.label: Moon Base dollars committed to date, including options
derived.notes: Warning, and it travels with this number everywhere it renders: the total includes Blue Origin's $280.4M option period, which has not been exercised. The base total, options excluded, is $1.292B. Publishing the headline $1.6B without this note is the exact species of imprecision this publication exists to correct.

derived.label: Moon Base dollars committed to date, options excluded
derived.notes: Base awards only. Excludes Blue Origin's unexercised $280.4M option period. The with-options figure is moonbase.committed.total.

derived.label: Share of the planned Moon Base investment that is signed
derived.notes: Numerator includes Blue Origin's unexercised $280.4M option. Denominator is the approximately $20B planned Phase 1 and 2 investment, a spoken figure, not an appropriation. Both choices are named because both move the percentage.

derived.label: Days since the last Moon Base award
derived.notes: Computed at render time from the latest award date in the ledger. Live by definition.

derived.label: Moon Base cost per American per year
derived.notes: The denominator is a choice and it is contested: 342 million is the total US resident population, 2024 vintage. Tax returns or net positive taxpayers each give a different answer. Spread across the seven-year Phase 1 and 2 window. Roughly $8 per American per year.
